items.quote: And Jethro, Moses' father in law, took a burnt offering and sacrifices for God: and Aaron came, and all the elders of Israel, to eat bread with Moses' father in law before God.
items.claim: Jethro (Moses' father-in-law) took a burnt offering and sacrifices for God; Aaron and all the elders of Israel came to eat bread with him before God.
items.action: took a burnt offering and sacrifices
